title: MCP tool call authorization decision
description: Result of data.mcp.main.decision. Run the call only when allow is true. When require_approval is true, hold the call for a human; allow stays false so an integration that ignores the flag fails closed.

allow.description: True only if a rule allowed the call, nothing denied it and no approval is pending.

deny.description: Every reason the call was refused. Empty when allowed or when approval is pending.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. May change between releases; do not match on it.

pack.description: The pack that produced this reason.

require_approval.description: True when the call may run only after a human approves it. Never true alongside a non-empty deny list.

obligations.description: Actions the integration should take with the decision.

audit_tags.description: Tags to attach to the audit record for this call.

policy_version.description: Version of this library that produced the decision.
